scope: exception review: broad historical source concept

records.caution: POWO accepts true Mimosa quadrivalvis L. as a distinct species, but older broad-sense Mimosa quadrivalvis records may refer to taxa now independently accepted. Historical M. quadrivalvis var. nuttallii maps to M. nuttallii, while var. angustata maps to M. microphylla. The source-pool species label alone does not establish identity of either original observation.
records.learner_action: Keep original source name; do not install a new true M. quadrivalvis card or relabel observations without voucher/photo and historical concept review. Avoid merging M. nuttallii and M. microphylla.
records.hold_resolution: Accepted botanical species name verified; original source observations remain identity-held
